text: These photos are all different shapes, and I’d like you to put them together into one reel rather than leave them as separate pictures. I’m excited to see them together because they remind me of a nice café visit. Please use this storefront pic first, then this latte pic, this pastries pic, this barista pic, and finally this interior pic, with the whole thing being one 10-second vertical reel. Keep each whole photo visible, so please don’t stretch any of them or crop anything out to make them fit. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps around the photos. There should be no music or text.
